card.statement:
Let $\lambda\in\mathfrak{h}^*$, $\pi$ a basis of the root system, $L(\lambda)=L_{\mathfrak b(\pi)}(\lambda)$ an admissible highest weight module in the minimal orbit (with respect to the Borel subalgebra $\mathfrak b(\pi)$) and $\beta\in \pi$ is such that $\left<\lambda,\beta^{\vee} \right> \notin\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}$. Then

[a)]

- The module $L_{\mathfrak b(s_{\beta}\pi)}(s_{\beta}(\lambda+\beta))$ is an admissible $s_{\beta}\Gamma$-relation Gelfand--Tsetlin module in the minimal orbit.

- Let $i>1$, $\beta=\beta_i$ the first simple root of $\pi$ such that $\left<\lambda,\beta^{\vee} \right> \notin\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}$ and $w=s_{i-1} s_i s_{i-2} s_{i-1} \cdots  
s_2s_1s_3s_1s_2 \in W$. Then $L_{\mathfrak b(w^{-1}\pi)}(w^{-1}\lambda)$ is a $\Gamma$-relation Gelfand--Tsetlin module in the minimal orbit.

- For any $x\in \mathbb C$, $D_{f_{\beta}}^x L(\lambda)$ is a $w\Gamma$-relation Gelfand--Tsetlin module in the minimal orbit.
card.label: Corollary 51

paper.title: Simple modules for Affine vertex algebras in the minimal nilpotent orbit
paper.abstract: We explicitly construct, in terms of Gelfand--Tsetlin tableaux, a new family of simple positive energy representations for the simple affine vertex algebra V_k(sl_{n+1}) in the minimal nilpotent orbit of sl_{n+1}. These representations are quotients of induced modules over the affine Kac-Moody algebra of sl_n+1 and include in particular all admissible simple highest weight modules and all simple modules induced from sl_2. Any such simple module in the minimal nilpotent orbit has bounded weight multiplicities.
